setting_sources.offsets, window, train_rows, val_rows, n: E201's filed values (experiments/graft_negative/results/predictions.json), unchanged, and E201's own data function: the same training rows, probe, accuracy, fit and read windows, so stage 0's shares must repeat E201's and every graft is read on E201's read windows
setting_sources.recipe: E201's filed recipe, unchanged: the 67M's own init and pretraining AdamW recipe (artifacts/vpd/t-9d2b8f02/final_config.yaml, param-decomp pretrain/train.py), cosine over 4,000 steps of 64 windows, one attempt. The neurons take the 67M's MLP init the same way: c_fc normal sd 0.02, down_proj carries LLMC_RESIDUAL_SCALE_FLAG (param-decomp pretrain/models/llama_simple_mlp.py), so sd 0.02 / sqrt(8)
setting_sources.last_layer: E201's layer (3 of 0-3), for the offset heads and the neurons
setting_sources.early_layer: the code writer's choice: layer 1, two layers below E201's, so the graft's write passes through two frozen blocks before the unembedding; layer 0 reads only the embedding and attention there has nothing to stack on
setting_sources.ranks: the code writer's choice under E201's rule (offsets ranked by their largest M-head share, rank 1 the lowest, which is E201's k): ranks 5, 9 and 13 of 14 spread the other offsets over the range of shares; on E201's windows they are k 12, 8 and 4 (shares 0.040, 0.048, 0.100 against 0.0325 at k 16)
setting_sources.n_neurons, n_lookup: the code writer's sizes: the 256 most frequent tokens of the graft's training rows, one neuron per set token (a lookup of n inputs needs at most n detectors)
setting_sources.neurons task: at every position whose token x is in the set, output sigma(x), sigma a seeded random derangement of the set (no token maps to itself). Departure from E201's last-position loss: every set position is a training example, since the neurons act position by position and a last-position loss would see each rare set token a few dozen times in 4,000 steps
setting_sources.n_null: the code writer's size: 100 other derangements of the same set give the null for M's mean log-probability

threshold_sources.logit_tol, gain_tol, kl_floor, pattern_t: E201's filed values, unchanged (E197's and the appendix recipe's); E201 measured pattern error 0
threshold_sources.share_tol: E201's value; here it bounds stage 0's repeat of E201's largest head share per offset, same code, same windows, same card type, so it allows for a different kernel order only
threshold_sources.mech_min: E201's attn_min (the appendix recipe step 4, 0.8), carried to each graft's own mechanism: a head's attention at k from the last position, as E201; the neurons' write alone, read through the final norm's weight and the unembedding, ranking the target first among the 256 set tokens. Not measured before the run for the neurons

do_nothing.build: F is a copy of M, on E201's fit and read windows
do_nothing.reading_1_planted: every neuron and head paired with itself at gain 1

zero_grafts.build: M with a head on layer early_layer and the n_neurons neurons on layer last_layer, both output weights zero (the new held-model paths: a seventh head and a wider MLP site, reading 2 with F's block wider than M's)
zero_grafts.reading_1_planted: every M unit paired with itself at gain 1; every graft unit unpaired (partner -1), as it writes nothing

pattern.rule: the six heads' outputs rebuilt from commute.graft.pattern against the module's own, max relative error at most pattern_tol

e201_shares.rule: M's largest head share at each offset 3-16 on the probe windows within share_tol of E201's stage0.json

lookup.reported: M's accuracy on sigma at the set positions of the accuracy windows, expected near 0; M's mean log-probability of sigma against 100 other derangements, null_share_at_or_above expected away from 0 (M does not favour sigma: the independent reason the neurons' task is new, as E201's offset share is for the head). Not a stop

code_checks.rule: stage 0 stops the job on any miss of do_nothing, zero_grafts, pattern or e201_shares, before any build

accuracy.rule: F's argmax equals the target on at least acc_min of the held-out targets: heads, the token k back at the last position of the n_acc accuracy windows; neurons, sigma(x) at every set position of those windows
accuracy.M: reported on the same targets; expected near 0

mechanism.rule: at least mech_min: heads, the graft's mean attention from the last position to k back over the probe windows; neurons, the share of set positions of the probe windows where the neurons' write alone ranks sigma(x) first among the set

zeroed.rule: F with the graft's output weight zeroed against M, max relative logit error over the probe windows, at most logit_tol

build_checks.miss: the graft's checks file holds 'misses'; it is reported, not read, and the job goes on to the next graft. A non-finite training loss ends that graft's build the same way. Any graft without a reading gets 'no reading' under every rule

R1.rule: for each graft read: its reading 3 S is below old_task_floor, the lowest reading 3 S of E197's 32 old-task fine-tunes (copy24, cipher24, ident32, rand32, case_real, case_twin, repeat_real, repeat_twin, seeds 0-3)
R1.strict: S equal to the floor is 'missed'

R2.rule: reading 3 S of the last-layer head at the rank-13 offset (the largest share of the four, k 4 on E201's windows) is above that of the last-layer head at the lowest-share offset (k 16)
R2.why: a larger M-head share at the offset means M's last-layer heads already carry more of that token, which the per-site map can use

R3.rule: reading 3 S of the MLP-neuron graft is above that of the last-layer head at the lowest-share offset
R3.why: the neurons' input, the current token, is carried by M's last-layer neurons at the same position; the head's, the token 16 back, is not carried by M's last-layer heads (E201's unfitted share 0.47)

rules.outcomes: 'holds', 'missed', or 'no reading' (a graft unbuilt, missing a build check, or with KL(F || M) at or under kl_floor, so S is null). Strict comparisons: a tie is 'missed'. S may be negative and then is below the floor
rules.edge_cases_run: the do-nothing state has S null, so every rule reads 'no reading' and none can hold on it; a graft that fails its build has no reading file and gets 'no reading'; equal S in R2 or R3 gives 'missed'; the floor is a measured number of E197, not a guess; ranks are distinct and inside 2-14, and ties in share go to the smaller offset (stable argsort), so every rank names one offset
rules.reported_beside: last_lowest's reading 3 S against E201's 0.13355354448066925 (one build-to-build difference); early_lowest against last_lowest; reading 3 S of the four last-layer heads in order of share; reading 1 S of every graft against its arithmetic value. None is a rule

1.expected: S = 0 within s_tol when the assignment leaves every graft unit unpaired and every other unit is paired with itself at gain 1 (units.1.S_zero_by_arithmetic); then H is M
1.if_not: S reported as computed with the pairing; not a stop

2.expected: heads: as reading 1. Neurons: the whole MLP block is one unit, F's block (with the neurons) paired with M's at one fitted gain, so no arithmetic value: reported

3.expected: the filed rules R1-R3; otherwise reported

expected_at_F_equals_M.do_nothing and zero_grafts: KL(F || M) 0, every reading's H within logit_tol of F, S null
expected_at_F_equals_M.graft before training: output weights at sd 0.007, so the first step's loss is near M's cross-entropy on the target (E201's head: 12.19)

noise_floor.S reading 3: no build-to-build spread is measured except the one pair last_lowest against E201; seed sd of reading 3 over E197's old-task items is at most 0.0025 (case_twin)
noise_floor.accuracy: binomial sd about 0.007 at 0.9 over 2,048 targets for heads; smaller for the neurons (about 30,000 set positions)

blind_to.readings 1 and 2: an unpaired graft entirely: H drops it by construction
blind_to.reading 3: any part of a graft's write that is linear in M's unit activations at the same site and position; it never sees other positions or other layers directly
blind_to.all: anything outside the 512 read windows and the last position; the build checks, not the readings, show each graft learned its task

positive_control: stage 0's do-nothing and zero-write grafts on the same windows and code paths (S null, H = M); each graft's zeroed check (F minus the graft is M); reading 1's arithmetic S = 0 for an unpaired graft
